scraped.title: Supporting the private and financial sector in Ghana
scraped.subtitle: Support to the Private and Financial Sector (PFS) in Ghana
scraped.financing: European Union (EU)- Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
scraped.clientName: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
scraped.description: ICON and Deutsche Sparkassenstiftung für Internationale Kooperation (DSIK) jointly implement the this project, aiming to enhance the economic landscape for micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) through the implementation of four key outputs, each designed to…
body: ICON and Deutsche Sparkassenstiftung für Internationale Kooperation (DSIK) jointly implement the this project, aiming to enhance the economic landscape for micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) through the implementation of four key outputs, each designed to create synergies and foster impactful change across multiple areas:

Enhanced Financial Services for MSMEs: The project improves the availability of demand-oriented financial services, enabling MSMEs to access tailored financial products that meet their specific needs.

Strengthened Regional Networks: Efforts are focused on expanding the range of services provided by regional networks for MSMEs. This enhancement aims to encourage greater utilization of these networks, fostering collaboration and support among enterprises.

Empowering Returnees and Potential Migrants: Access to employment services is facilitated for returnees and potential migrants through the established network. This initiative seeks to secure sustainable employment opportunities for individuals participating in qualification programs.

Promoting Green Business Opportunities: Pilot measures are being implemented to support green business initiatives for MSMEs. This output aims to create quality jobs while promoting sustainable practices within the sector.
Together, these activities are strategically aligned to achieve the overarching objective of empowering MSMEs and fostering a resilient economy.
